title: Scheduler core: cron jobs, run loop & run history

user_story.i_want: a scheduler that runs registered jobs on cron schedules and records every run
user_story.so_that: background work happens on time and is auditable

description: Define a `Job` trait: `name()`, `schedule()` (cron, UTC) and an async `run(&JobContext)` returning a JobOutcome or an error. The registry holds `Vec<Arc<dyn Job>>`. Each job gets its own loop: compute the next fire time with croner, sleep until then, run with a timeout, and write a `job_runs` row (start, end, status, error, details JSON). The same job never overlaps itself in-process; an overlapping run is skipped with a WARN. Config can disable a job or override its schedule. Include a `heartbeat` job (every minute) for testing, plus `/healthz` on :8082.

acceptance_criteria.then: 3 job_runs rows exist, each started at second 0 (±1 s)

acceptance_criteria.given: a job that returns an error or panics
acceptance_criteria.then: the run is recorded as failed with the message, and other jobs keep running
it is cancelled and recorded as timed_out

acceptance_criteria.given: a run still in progress when the next tick fires
acceptance_criteria.then: the new run is skipped with a WARN
results are correct without real waiting

rust_concepts: async fn in traits and dyn compatibility (async-trait or BoxFuture)

references.title: The Rust Book ch.15: Smart pointers (Box, Rc, Arc...)
